# Non-itemizer or itemized? Compare your 2026 charitable deduction.

> Free calculator comparing two 2026 OBBBA charitable-giving paths: the new $1,000/$2,000 above-the-line deduction for non-itemizers vs. itemizing cash gifts after the new 0.5%-of-AGI floor. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
